task_message:
Case M14: segment the myxoid soft-tissue tumor on this T2-weighted MRI.

Volume: 220x220x300 voxels, 1 mm isotropic. Budgets: max 40 tool calls / 15 model prompts / 10 min wall time.
Start with `seg_open`. Finish with `seg_finish`.
final_assistant_text: Segmentation complete. Myxoid tumor is the well-circumscribed T2-bright ovoid mass in the posterior-lateral gluteal soft tissues. Single positive point produced a 19.8 mL single-component mask (axial 187-241, coronal 70-98, sagittal 58-92) that follows the bright border tightly in all three planes with appropriate tapering at the ends and no residual lesion in past-mask panels. Candidates C2/C3 are distant vessels and C1 is thin rim/vessel, all rejected.
